name: Student Missions
description_short: Short task cards that send students out into the world — or into their phone — to find, observe, and report back.
teacher_note: Students tend to actually do these. The mission framing seems to help.
creator: Free Range Tutors
internal_notes: Formerly dual-intent (teach + homework) under the retired 'intent' field, per the Stage 4.5 migration brief's own example: cards work as an in-class task, but the 'into their phone, report back' framing is equally, genuinely a take-home assignment. That distinction has no home in the new directory-model schema (Phase 1 of the directory rework) beyond this note — worth a dedicated 'homework_suitable' style field later if it turns out to matter in practice, per the directory architecture spec's Phase 2 list.
